validation_notes: DEDUP-001 (H-01): Validated as High. The 'first qualifying caller wins' design intent inferred from 'anyone can claim' is NOT what the NatSpec describes - the nudge is explicitly intended to incentivize legitimate large-batch users. The implemented mechanism makes that intent structurally unreachable. Plus ECON-010 (recipient = NFTStaker) is a clean permanent-loss path.

DEDUP-004 (L-03): VECTOR CLOSED AT PRODUCTION WIRING. Verified NFTMinterV2 uses `_mint` (not `_safeMint`) at /home/justin/code/C4/solidity-audit/lib/yield-claim-nft/src/V2/NFTMinterV2.sol:196. OpenZeppelin's ERC1155._mint does not invoke _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck, so the receiver hook never fires from the BatchNFTMinter mint loop. Downgraded from sanitizer's 'high (PoC pending)' to L-03 defense-in-depth.

DEDUP-006 (M-01): Validated as Medium. Cross-contract chain confirmed by NFTStaker.sol comments at lines 21, 107, 343-345 - latestPrice is read into rewardRate. Compounds with H-01 but not directly High because no theft of staker principal or accrued rewards.
DEDUP-007 (L-05): Confirmed Low. Mint-debt feedback into V (50% of mint payment routes to NFTStaker) partially self-funds the rate spike, defeating clean profit extraction.

H-01: Owner has configured nudgeSize > 0 and nudgePaymentToken != address(0).
External funder has transferred nudgePaymentToken into BatchNFTMinter.
Attacker has phUSD sufficient for cost(nudgeSize) mints (~5K phUSD at typical params).
